description: Use this when you need on-chain facts about a Solana SPL token mint before interacting with it: mint and freeze authority, supply, decimals, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook...) and factual flags. Facts only, no verdict. Automated facts, not financial advice. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402, eip155:8453); pay by attaching an x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"] after the first call returns the payment requirements. Free trial: 25 free calls, no wallet needed: get a key with get_trial_key (or POST /trial-key) and send it in params._meta["trial_key"] or the X-Trial-Key HTTP header.
